meta.name: board-deck-builder
meta.description: Assembles comprehensive board and investor update decks by pulling perspectives from all C-suite roles. Use when preparing board meetings, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising narratives. Covers structure, narrative framework, bad news delivery, and common mistakes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成董事会和投资人汇报材料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要准备面向董事会或投资人的正式汇报材料
copy.tagline_en: Quickly assemble board and investor update decks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare formal presentations for board or investors

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你生成董事会或投资人汇报用的演示文稿。它会从CEO、CFO等高管视角组织内容，包含数据、叙事和下一步行动，并自动填充你提供的指标，缺失部分用占位符标记。
howto.when: 当你需要准备董事会会议、投资人更新、季度业务回顾或融资材料时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个季度董事会汇报，我们是A轮公司。
say.note: 技能会按标准结构生成完整文稿。

say.text: 起草一份种子轮公司的融资演示文稿。
say.note: 技能会调整内容侧重市场与愿景。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you create board or investor update decks. It organizes content from CEO, CFO, and other C-suite perspectives, including data, narrative, and next steps. It fills in metrics you provide and uses placeholders for missing data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to prepare board meetings, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising materials.

say_en.text: Build a quarterly board deck — we're Series A.
say_en.note: The skill generates a full deck with standard structure.

say_en.text: Draft a fundraising board deck for a seed-stage company.
say_en.note: The skill adjusts content to emphasize market and vision.
